name: fomopulse
description: Live tape of what tracked wallets buy and sell on-chain. First target: fomo.family traders on Robinhood Chain.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.cf:dev: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/worker dev
scripts.cf:deploy: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/worker deploy
